newFindings.title: The withhold is decided from the tentative record: a field test the same review then refuses as earlier than the record still withholds the move
newFindings.where: v1-run-index.mjs lines 63-68 (replacedByTests reads tentative.record) versus line 74 (the declaration is refused with evidence.reviewBeforeTheRecord)

reproduction.steps: weeks 0..q reviewed; in week q+1 a review at 21:00 declares a race (recorded); then a MISSED_SESSION review of that week's quality session at 20:30 the same day, sent without referenceState and actualLedger but with the carried record, declaring a FIELD_TEST naming the session
reproduction.observed: frozen engine MODIFY/MOVE; extended KEEP/KEEP (equal to the engine under withhold MOVE); runEvidence.refused [{id:'t-rc01', errors:['evidence.reviewBeforeTheRecord']}]

newFindings.expected: Contract: the withhold applies only for 'an accepted field test of this athlete'. A refused declaration changes no engine decision.
newFindings.whyNotBlocking: Reachable only when a client sends an evidence record newer than the reference state and ledger it sends with it (state from different versions). In a conforming flow the engine itself refuses the earlier review on its clock (r02). The effect is KEEP instead of MOVE: the missed harder session is not moved to a later day, which is the less-load direction. The refusal is named, so the athlete can declare again.
newFindings.condition: Owner: author of v1-run-index.mjs, at the next change of the entry point. Compute the withhold from the record that will actually be appended (after the reviewNotAccepted / reviewBeforeTheRecord checks), and add a test. Until then integration sends the record, the ledger and the reference state from the same last response.

newFindings.title: The contract's week rule does not name its immediate exceptions
newFindings.where: RUN_CALIBRATION_CONTRACT_V1RC.md 'Rules': 'A week's calibration reads only what was on the record before the week started. It does not move inside the week.'
newFindings.observed: Immediate inside the week: withdrawal (hold, break, return mode); warningSignScreen REQUIRED and assessment NOT_OFFERED on a not-tolerated or symptom-stopped result (documented by the fix cycle as intended); TEST_ALREADY_DONE_THIS_WEEK on a later harder session of the current week once a test is declared (r03c: changes on Monday evening; a test stopped for pacing counts too); RC-02's corrections. The first two are the deliberate safety exceptions. TEST_ALREADY_DONE_THIS_WEEK is the one other new immediate effect, in the withdrawing direction.
newFindings.expected: A client that trusts 'does not move inside the week' may cache the week's session guidance and keep showing a pace band on a harder session that the extension has turned to effort only after a test.
newFindings.condition: Owner: author of the contract. Before integration, name the immediate exceptions and the NOT_RAISED status in the contract, and state that the client takes session guidance from each result.

newFindings.title: Rules added by the fix cycle still unpinned by the directed tests (12 of 42 fresh mutants survive)
newFindings.details: Survivors: F01 (withhold for any evidence kind: the test's race result is dated in the previous week, so the week check acts first), F03 (withhold while off from a carried test row), F04 (any session role: masked, the frozen engine never moves a missed non-quality session), F07/F08/F09 (the monotonic 'never earlier than the record' check: the QRE-02 test accepts either refusal, and its bare-review assertion passes when the row is added), F15 (heart-rate known() ignores recordedOn: matters for LAB_TEST rows, which classify marks HEART_RATE_ONLY before the in-force checks), F21 (clamp keeps the old slow edge), F22 (a stop with no stated reason read as OTHER: the R-01 test always also sends tolerated:false), F37 (longest run reads superseded rows), F40 (observed-easy validUntil from the newest run), F42 (flag ignores corrections). On the candidate my probes show correct behaviour for F01 (r01 race result in the session's week: MOVE), F03 (r17: MOVE), F07 (r02: refused reviewBeforeTheRecord), F15 (r03 f: lab declared Thursday not shown until next week), F22 (r16: SYMPTOM, screen REQUIRED). Run against the mutants in my copy, the same probes detect F01, F03, F07, F15 and F22 (mutprobe-*.out). F42 changes RC-02's behaviour.
newFindings.whyNotBlocking: The defects these mutants represent are absent from the candidate (verified above). What is missing is regression protection, most importantly for the R-01 missing-reason rule (F22) and the QRE-02 monotonic rule (F07).
newFindings.condition: Owner: author. Add directed tests for F22, F07, F03, F01 and F15 at the next change to these files; until then any edit to v1-run-index.mjs or the R-01 reader is re-reviewed.

Invariants over 60 random athletes and 360 weekly reviews with random tests, stops and tolerance: LONG never faster than EASY, RECOVERY never faster than LONG, THRESHOLD never faster than TEN_K, every session pace equals its week's band, no band in a WALK_JOG/RESTART/RETURN week, no estimate other than the marathon without a STANDARD capacity, no engine difference: 0 issues.

freezeScript.reading: Unchanged since bc40218 (sha 8b90ddb4...). ADDED already lists scripts/v1rc-fuzz.mjs and the whole audits/coachingcore-v1-run-calibration-2026-11-11 directory (so reviews/, including these recheck files and the SSCTR records file, once tracked). testFiles() binds every tracked CoachingCore/test/v1rc-*.test.mjs, so v1rc-review-fixes.test.mjs and v1rc-review-fixes-qre.test.mjs are bound once committed. --check recomputes over the union of recorded and currently tracked files and reports drift for a changed, added-and-tracked or removed added file, a changed FREEZE-1 file (preserved().changed) or a changed FREEZE-1 record (sha against additiveTo.sha256). Limits: it sees tracked files only (an untracked file is invisible until added); a recorded file deleted from disk makes sha() throw, which exits non-zero (fails closed, though with no drift report); a later append to SSCTR_V1RC_RUN_RECORDS.json shows as drift, which is correct. --write refuses dirty or untracked bound paths and a HEAD that differs from the named commit. Not executed with --write/--check (no git in the extract, and no record may be written).
